source_text.body:
Send letters and build trip summaries with Grok Bot
Users had Grok Bot send a letter to corporate while driving and compile a trip summary from chats, locations, calendar, and booking emails into markdown.
·
Oct 23, 2026
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
One user said they had Grok Bot write a letter to corporate and send it while they were driving away. Another built a travel agent bot with their itinerary, a webhook fed by a tiny iPhone GPS app Grok Bot had Claude Code make, and then asked it on the way home to turn chats, location pings, calendar entries, booking emails, and OneDrive photos into a markdown trip summary that it later rebuilt after a few date fixes.
How it went
The trip bot produced a 12-page PDF with a day-by-day review, captions, and about two dozen timestamped photos; the user only corrected a couple of dates before regenerating it. The letter-sending example reports it worked, but gives no process details or measurable result.
Worth knowing
For the trip setup, the biggest catch was extra plumbing: the user needed a separate iPhone location app posting GPS to the bot’s webhook, then manually corrected dates the next morning.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
I took a trip to [destination] from [dates]. Use my calendar, booking confirmation emails, and location history from that period to compile a trip summary in markdown with a day-by-day itinerary, places visited, costs, and confirmation numbers. Separately, draft a letter to [company or person] about [issue] and show it to me before sending it. You're done when I have the summary file and the approved letter.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1xb9hsw/whats_the_craziest_thing_you_have_used_grok_bot_for
